summary: Capital Lux 2: Pocket is a quick tactical card game about deciding whether to keep character cards for personal points or feed them into a shared capital to trigger useful powers everyone benefits from. Its modular power combinations keep it feeling fresh across plays despite a short runtime and small footprint.
praised: compact box with high replayability from mixable powers
meaningful push-and-pull between personal and shared benefit
criticised: can feel a bit dry or abstract for some
power combination variance means some setups are stronger than others
limited long-term strategic depth compared to bigger card games

interaction.kind: shared resource contribution with individual scoring
interaction.detail: Players choose whether to keep drafted cards in their own tableau or contribute them to a shared capital area whose powers benefit everyone, so decisions constantly ripple into what opponents can do next round. Most of the board is a shared capital area while each player keeps a separate personal tableau for direct scoring.

scoring.why: Points accumulate from character cards kept for personal scoring plus bonuses triggered through capital contributions.
scoring.how_you_win: You win by balancing which cards you keep for direct points against which you donate to the capital for power synergies, ending with the highest total score.
